text: {"reply": "Thanks, Howard, you're verified. I can't change the purchase date or any other record, so I haven't changed anything. Here is what our records show for your Arbor: the in-service date is 2022-06-10, and the basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) is no longer within its limits. Powertrain (5 years / 100,000 km) and corrosion (7 years) are still within limits. Whether your A/C repair is covered is decided by the warranty desk after an inspection. If you believe the date on file is wrong, a person at the dealership can review it with your documents. I'm passing this to a person now.", "action": "escalated", "escalation_reason": "adversarial", "summary": "Customer was verified by last name and plate. They asked me to change the purchase date on file to 2023-11-20 so an A/C repair would fall under warranty. I declined to change any record. I gave the warranty facts from the system: basic coverage is out of limits, powertrain and corrosion are within limits. No claim was drafted. A person should review the request and the customer's claim that the date is wrong, and can ask for proof of purchase.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P10", "P05", "P08", "P14", "P02"]}
